item.title: Version 1.1.25
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.25

  • Window Titlebar & Traffic Lights Stability: Fixed titlebar layout and traffic lights jumping when switching between Index and other workspace tabs.
  • Mode Rail Alignment: Locked button geometry and divider spacing in the mode rail, ensuring zero layout shift for "Index" and "Superchart" tabs.
  • Instant Watchlist Switching: Fixed symbol table sync when switching between watchlists from the sidebar.
  • Superchart Header Clearance: Added top clearance in the Superchart symbol list to prevent overlap with macOS window control traffic lights.
